notes: Adds recovery logic, TTL enforcement edge cases, and validation coverage to complete feature.

GOV-F-003-S152.title: Lock Expiration and Recovery Logic
GOV-F-003-S152.description: Implement automatic detection and recovery of expired Brain locks. Allow new owner to safely acquire lock if TTL expired, with conflict resolution and stale lock cleanup.

GOV-F-003-S153.title: Heartbeat Failure and TTL Edge Case Handling
GOV-F-003-S153.description: Handle edge cases where heartbeat fails or is delayed, including partial expiration windows, race conditions, and double-acquire scenarios. Ensure strict consistency under concurrent access.

GOV-F-003-S154.title: Lock State Validation and Guardrails
GOV-F-003-S154.description: Implement validation checks to prevent invalid lock states including orphaned locks, missing owners, or invalid TTL values. Enforce invariants at read/write boundaries.

GOV-F-003-S155.title: Lock Mechanism Unit and Concurrency Tests
GOV-F-003-S155.description: Create unit and concurrency tests simulating multiple agents attempting to acquire, renew, and recover locks. Validate TTL expiration, ownership enforcement, and recovery correctness.

GOV-F-003.mitigation: Enforce strict TTL, ownership validation, and recovery rules with test coverage.
